title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to architect, build, and scale high-throughput distributed microservices. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Python (FastAPI/Django), PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes, coupled with strong system design, problem-solving, and engineering leadership skills.
